style.styleTitle: Homcom 5ft Artificial Fir Christmas Tree with Tips
style.toneOfVoice: Holiday decorating can feel rushed when a sparse tree looks flat and setup steals your evening. This HOMCOM 5 ft Christmas tree transforms the mood with 490 branch tips, PE, PVC, and pine needle foliage for a full, lifelike appearance, while 51 white berries and 51 large berry ornaments add festive charm. A 2-section hinged trunk with auto-expand branches speeds up setup, helping your living room look beautifully decorated sooner. . 490 branch tips create a full, natural-looking Christmas tree with 51 white berries and 51 large berry ornaments; . Mixed PE, PVC, and pine needle foliage delivers a realistic look with lasting seasonal charm; . 2-section trunk with pre-attached hinged branches opens automatically for quick setup and shaping in 15–25 minutes; . Sectional design disassembles into a compact size for convenient off-season storage; . Fire-retardant branch tips provide added peace of mind throughout the holiday season; . Foldable metal base keeps the tree stable and upright while allowing compact storage after use; . Brings festive charm and a warm holiday atmosphere to any indoor space; . Colour: Green; . Material: PE, PVC, Metal, Pine Needles; . Overall Dimensions: F88 x 150H cm; . Base Diameter: 35 cm; . Branch Tip Count: 490; . Item Label: 83C-303V00GN; . Shaping Note: In order to get a full appearance, please spread out all individual branch tips to get the best possible look;
